verdict.rationale: Isaac is a robotics development platform, so fleet deployment is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only shows packaging a policy into a portable deployment bundle and running ROS packages on Jetson. Nothing documents over-the-air update delivery, staged or canary rollouts, or rollback.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can deploy software updates over-the-air to robots with staged rollouts and rollback
